inputs.text: Listen, this so-called political transition in Cuba isn't some organic shift—it's a straight-up setup by the hidden elites and institutions pulling the strings. They've made damn sure the locals stay broke and own nothing so they can't step in themselves, leaving the door wide open for the wealthy diaspora crowd and foreign investors to swoop in and grab all the property and businesses for pennies. It's coordinated manipulation from the same global interests that have always been in charge, handing over control while pretending it's something else entirely.
